name: reprice_zero_total_guard_20261105
comment: ANCHOR: REPRICE_ZERO_TOTAL_GUARD_20261105 - the */15 repricer summed account totals with `or 0` and skipped its drift
guard whenever the result was zero, so an empty or unpriced holdings document wrote a plausible $0 over a real total
through a raw write_text. These tests pin the refusal (empty document, unpriced holding, absent summaries), the
genuine-zero control that must NOT be refused, and the guard shape that makes 100% drift evaluable.
